messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":3,"verses":[{"chapter":3,"verse":11,"text":"11 Guard the vessels of the temple service until the gathering of the beloved.’”"},{"chapter":3,"verse":12,"text":"12 And Jeremiah spoke, saying: “I beg you, Lord, show me what I should do for Abimelech the Ethiopian, for he has done many kindnesses to your servant Jeremiah."},{"chapter":3,"verse":13,"text":"13 For he pulled me out of the muddy pit, and I do not want him to see the destruction and desolation of this city, but I want you to be merciful to him and spare him grief.”"},{"chapter":3,"verse":14,"text":"14 And the Lord said to Jeremiah: “Send him to the vineyard of Agrippa, and I will hide him in the shadow of the mountain until I cause the people to return to the city."},{"chapter":3,"verse":15,"text":"15 And you, Jeremiah, go with your people into Babylon and stay with them, preaching to them, until I cause them to return to the city."}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 11,12,13,14,15 in this chapter.
